transcript: Speaker A: मैं टूट गई थी इस हादसे के बाद से। पांच बच्चों के साथ ट्रेन में अकेला छोड़ गया। मेरा नाम सायरा है... [I was broken after this incident. Left alone on a train with five children. My name is Saira...] ...अगर आप भी किसी स्टेशन पर अकेली छोड़ दी गई हैं... तो इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [...If you too have been left alone at some station in life, download the English Seekho app.] Speaker B: इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW. [English Seekho, INSTALL NOW. Disclaimer: English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority. Results depend on individual effort.]
summary: Saira shares her emotional journey of being abandoned by her husband with five children. After facing job rejections due to her lack of English, she used the English Seekho app's 1-rupee trial to learn and secure a call center job. She encourages other struggling women to download the app to become independent.
